process_issues.description: Every Bash call failed at sandbox startup, before the command ran: `apply-seccomp: write /proc/self/setgroups (nested userns is capability-restricted; caller must provide CAP_SYS_ADMIN): Permission denied`. This hit `gh pr view 237`, `git diff --stat <merge_base>..HEAD` and `git rev-parse HEAD`, so the PR diff, metadata, threads and head SHA could not be read.

No reviewers were started: with no way to read the diff, findings could not point to changed lines, and subagents would hit the same Bash failure. PR #237 was NOT reviewed; re-run once the runner allows the bubblewrap/seccomp sandbox (nested user namespaces) or Bash runs without it.

incomplete_reason: Not reviewed: no reviewer was spawned; re-run
